title: Bit encoding of a machine action
statement: For an action of a machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states in a set of size $n+1$, form a bit string by concatenating the encoding of the input-head movement, then for each work tape the encodings of its optional write instruction and head movement, followed by the output-symbol encoding and successor-state encoding.
hypotheses_covered: An action with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and states indexed by the $n+1$ elements of a finite set
caveat: The helper encodings are not defined in the supplied statement, so their exact bit representations cannot be described.
